status: First data drop of the geometric LOD study (stages R3 main and R4 heat transfer, D-193). A consolidated drop after the R5 serial timing pass and the R6 report replaces these files in place with the same layout; the site loader admits added fields (ADR 0050).

study.name: lod-study-v1
study.title: How Much Thermal Zoning Detail Is Enough?
study.design: Each test case is one DOE/PNNL prototype building generated by BEMGen's DOE generator at the prototype's own dimensions, with the prototype's atlas programs (deterministic ruleset schedules), the atlas 90.1 unified construction set of its vintage and climate zone, and the pinned TMY3 weather of the zone's representative city. The reference site is the prototype's full zoning (NoSimplification + Stack, IWHT and FHT on); the test sites are the zoning simplifications with geometry, programs, envelope and weather fixed. Ideal-loads sensible heating and cooling are the primary outputs; HVAC and service hot water are excluded.

threshold.basis: ASHRAE Guideline 14 hourly limits (CV(RMSE) 30 %, NMBE 10 %), annual error 10 %, conditioned area 1 %; proposed, the owner decides

lod-recommendations.json.label: R3 main matrix
lod-recommendations.json.content: 11 prototypes x 6 climate zones (2A, 2B, 3C, 4A, 5A, 7A) x 2 vintages (90.1-2007, 90.1-2019) x 2 orientations (0, 45 degrees), 264 test cases, the 24 main zonings (IWHT and FHT on) each
lod-recommendations.json.transformation: copied byte for byte except CRLF line endings normalised to LF (source_sha256 is the writer's file, sha256 the repository file)

lod-recommendations-ht.json.label: R4 heat-transfer sub-study
lod-recommendations-ht.json.content: 11 prototypes x 2 climate zones (3C, 5A) x 90.1-2019 x 0 degrees, 22 test cases, the 24 main zonings x interior-wall heat transfer (IWHT) on and off x floor heat transfer (FHT) on and off, 96 zonings each
lod-recommendations-ht.json.transformation: copied byte for byte except CRLF line endings normalised to LF (source_sha256 is the writer's file, sha256 the repository file)
